title: TCPA Compliance Checklist: 12 Checks Before an AI Agent Dials
meta_description: A 12-point TCPA compliance checklist from 47 CFR 64.1200: written consent, 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. solicitations, the 31-day DNC safe harbor, 10-business-day opt-outs.

image.takeaway: AI sales calls to cell phones need signed written consent, and opt-outs must be honored within 10 business days.
image.alt: Hero card for the TCPA compliance checklist: AI sales calls to cell phones need signed written consent, and opt-outs must be honored within 10 business days at most.

rows.label: Federal window for telephone solicitations

rows.label: Established business relationship window
rows.note: after a purchase; 3 months after an inquiry

Minimum ring time before hanging up

key_numbers.source: Read on 4 November 2026 from 47 CFR 64.1200 and 64.1601 on eCFR, 47 U.S.C. 227 on LII, the Eleventh Circuit opinion in No. 24-10277, FCC 24-17 and DA 24-1068 on docs.fcc.gov, and FCC 26-67 in the Federal Register.
